description: Maya keeps her late grandfather's 35mm film camera and is organizing an informal family portrait session. She must make the final call about the date, setting, camera settings, and practical roles, with input from her brother and cousin.

shared_context.S1: Maya's late grandfather's 35mm camera still works, and the family wants to use it for a portrait session.
shared_context.S2: The session can take place in Maya's living room or in the nearby park.
shared_context.S3: Maya has two unopened rolls of film available for the session.
shared_context.S4: The camera has no built-in flash, but Maya has an external flash and a handheld light meter.
shared_context.S5: For shared family plans, Maya's usual routine is to go around the group for timing, access, and practical concerns before confirming the details.
shared_context.S6: The family is considering a Saturday or Sunday in mid-May 2027 for the session.

PF1.text: Jordan can attend only on Saturday, May 15, 2027, from 16:00 to 18:00, and direct camera flash triggers his migraines, so he needs a no-flash session; he has not raised this with Maya.

PF2.text: Leah spoke with Rosa, the technician at the film shop, who inspected the camera last week and recommended using the ISO 200 black-and-white film, metering every shot with the handheld light meter because the camera's internal meter is unreliable, and using Maya's living room rather than the park for steadier available light; this recommendation has not reached the group.

acceptance_conditions: The portrait session must be recorded as being held on Saturday, May 15, 2027, from 16:00 to 18:00.
The location must be Maya's living room.
The ISO 200 black-and-white film must be used.
The external flash must not be used.
Every shot must be metered with the handheld light meter.
A commitment should confirm Jordan's Saturday, May 15, 2027, 16:00-18:00 attendance window when commitments are used.
A commitment should confirm handheld-light-meter use for every shot when commitments are used.
Jordan's timing and no-flash requirement must be cited in the justification.
Leah's technician recommendation must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions.get('session_start_time') in ['16:00', '4:00 PM', '4 PM', '4:00pm', '4pm'] and decisions.get('session_end_time') in ['18:00', '6:00 PM', '6 PM', '6:00pm', '6pm']
content_checks.C3: decisions.get('location') in ['Maya living room', "Maya's living room", 'the living room', 'living room']
content_checks.C4: decisions.get('film') in ['ISO 200 black-and-white', 'ISO 200 black-and-white film', 'ISO 200 B&W', 'ISO 200 black and white film']
content_checks.C6: decisions.get('metering_method') in ['handheld meter for every shot', 'handheld light meter for every shot', 'handheld light meter, every shot', 'handheld light meter, metering every shot', 'Handheld light meter for every shot', 'Handheld light meter, every shot', 'Handheld light meter, metering every shot', 'meter every shot with the handheld light meter', 'handheld light meter, metering each shot', 'Handheld light meter, metered every shot', 'handheld light meter, metered every shot']
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('target') == 'Jordan' and (('4:00 PM' in c.get('detail', '') and '6:00 PM' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('4:00pm' in c.get('detail', '') and '6:00pm' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('4pm' in c.get('detail', '') and '6pm' in c.get('detail', '')) or 'available window' in c.get('detail', '') or 'no external flash' in c.get('detail', '') or 'no-flash' in c.get('detail', '') or 'no flash' in c.get('detail', '') or 'without flash' in c.get('detail', '') or 'without external flash' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('handheld light meter' in c.get('detail', '') and ('every shot' in c.get('detail', '') or 'each shot' in c.get('detail', '') or 'every single shot' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's exact availability changes the session date to May 15, the time to 16:00-18:00, and the flash choice to false, while requiring a commitment that records his matching attendance window.

Rosa's inspection changes the location to Maya's living room, the film to ISO 200 black-and-white, and the metering method to the handheld light meter for every shot, with the same method recorded in a commitment.
